Then $a_n+L\\in S$, and among the integers strictly greater than $a_n$ and at most $a_n+L$ there are exactly $T$ members of $S$.","note":"Conditional on finite-prime dependence, the residue-counting assembly correctly gives periodicity from n=1."}},"S_ref":1,"notes":"The characterization and final periodicity assembly are sound, but the essential finiteness step rests entirely on a false set-theoretic lemma, so the overall proof is incomplete."}
